intro: Looking for government colleges for MBA in Kerala? This page ranks the public institutes in our records by average package. We currently link {{count}} programme options at {{colleges}} colleges tagged as public in our file.

IIM Kozhikode and NIT Calicut are the two public institutes on this list. Private and government-aided campuses, including St Aloysius College, Edathua, and St Joseph's College of Engineering and Technology, Kottayam, are no longer tagged as public in our file.
listLead: IIM Kozhikode appears first on the official 2025 flagship PGP card (mean ₹28.18 LPA, highest ₹81 LPA), followed by NIT Calicut's official MBA figures.
snapshot: Only two public colleges have recorded averages here, so we have not quoted a package median in this text. Read each official report, and be careful where an average and a highest figure do not line up.
IIM Kozhikode is 3rd, and NIT Calicut is 85th, in the official NIRF 2025 Management ranking. Use those official ranks when you compare top MBA / PGDM colleges in Kerala 2026.
firstCollegesLead: Our IIM Kozhikode card shows a recorded average of ₹31 LPA, while the first table has a 2023 highest of ₹25 LPA and no average on that row. Confirm both in the official placement report.
NIT Calicut's official CCD report for 2025-26 lists an MBA average of ₹9.31 LPA and a highest of ₹15 LPA (minimum ₹5.50 LPA). Use that official row, not any older inconsistent record.

sections.heading: Which colleges are on this government list
paragraphs: IIM Kozhikode and NIT Calicut are national public institutes, and they are the colleges tagged as public on this Kerala government MBA list.
St Aloysius College, Edathua, is a privately managed aided college, and St Joseph's College of Engineering and Technology, Palai, is a private self-financing college, so they no longer appear here.

sections.heading: Other government colleges for MBA in Kerala
paragraphs: Several state and central university departments in Kerala also run MBA programmes. They are not in the ranked list above because our records do not yet hold an average package for them, but they are worth a look if you want a government seat at a lower fee.
The admission rules below are from each institute's own 2026 notice. Check the 2027 notice before you apply, because tests, weightages and fees can change.

faqs.question: Which are the government colleges for MBA in Kerala?
faqs.answer: IIM Kozhikode and NIT Calicut are the public institutes ranked on this page. Other government options include the School of Management Studies at CUSAT, IMK at the University of Kerala, the Central University of Kerala and KITTS in Thiruvananthapuram.

faqs.question: How many government MBA colleges in Kerala are on this list?
faqs.answer: Our records link {{count}} programme options at {{colleges}} colleges tagged as public, currently IIM Kozhikode and NIT Calicut.

faqs.question: What is IIM Kozhikode's NIRF rank?
faqs.answer: In the official NIRF 2025 Management ranking, IIM Kozhikode is 3 and NIT Calicut is 85.

faqs.question: Why do the NIT Calicut figures look inconsistent?
faqs.answer: The official NIT Calicut CCD 2025-26 MBA row lists an average of ₹9.31 LPA and a highest of ₹15 LPA. Use that official report, not any older inconsistent record.

faqs.question: Are these packages guaranteed?
faqs.answer: No. They are historical records from {{pkgYearMin}} to {{pkgYearMax}} in our file. Confirm the latest official report before you decide.
